title: 3 red flags before debt review #DebtReview
text:
Whichever road you take, watch out for three red flags. One: a debt counsellor who isn't on the National Credit Regulator's register (you can check it yourself on the NCR website). Two: anyone who asks for big fees upfront, before you've even signed the application. Three: anyone who promises to make your debt disappear, or to remove debt review from your record overnight. If something goes wrong with a lender or a counsellor, you can complain to the National Financial Ombud.

Full guide: "Debt Review vs Debt Consolidation vs Debt Counselling: Which One Fits You? (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.

Sources
- National Credit Regulator, register of debt counsellors: https://www.ncr.org.za
- National Financial Ombud Scheme: https://www.nfosa.co.za
